name: Plus/Delta
description: The shortest format: what was good (plus) and what we would change (delta). It is perfect when time is short or the team is tired.

columns.name: Plus
columns.prompt: What went well and should we keep?

columns.name: Delta
columns.prompt: What would you change next time?

mood.tired: Only two columns, so it takes little energy.

goal.reflect-period: A quick look back at the period.

checkInQuestion: What is one small thing that made your week better?
facilitationTips: Keep the pace brisk: two minutes of silent writing per column is enough.
Treat every Delta as a chance to improve, not as a complaint.
Pick just one or two Deltas to turn into actions.
